normalization: Corrected broad_hub_screen.clean (iterated HTML entity decoding and allowlisted tags only), Unicode NFKC, casefold, Unicode alphanumeric tokens excluding underscore; join tokens by single spaces. Punctuation including hyphens is a boundary, not part of tokens.
matching: All overlapping normalized token sequences; fields searched separately; no substring within a token. All normalized aliases, including flagged terms, remain searchable except empty normalization.
hyphen_limit: Component aliases may match within hyphenated chemical names; adjoining hyphen is explicitly flagged. No derivative-to-parent efficacy attribution is allowed.
name_crossrefs: Full normalized-name equality only against catalog preferred/alias names, unverified-supplement names/aliases, FDA reported/retrieval names and curated match_aliases. FDA retrieval names only remove documented explicit regulatory suffixes. No fuzzy, CAS, structure, moiety, dose, mixture or product equivalence.
grouping_limit: DSLD source-defined synonym relations are not verified chemical equivalence. Repeated cells retain indices; pattern indexing does not erase source cells.
flag_limit: Flags are triage aids, not complete ambiguity detection, intervention review, efficacy or exclusion decisions.
positions: Zero-based token positions, end-exclusive, in the normalized decoded individual field. No raw abstract or snippet text written.
credit: No abstract-reading, primary-paper, biological-validation or drug-appraisal credit from this screen.
